OpsBot: Reminder: follow-up task created - update-retry-policy assigned to @Ben.
Ravi: Adding a tiny kudos to both on the board. Coffee or cookies for the MVPs? :coffee: :cookie:
Marta: :coffee: please!
Ben: Cookies sound perfect but I'll take the coffee. Thanks everyone.
Ravi: Done. Dropped a note to People Ops for a couple of vouchers. Appreciate the quick pivot :)
